A '''soldier''' was a member of [[Saw Gerrera]]'s [[Partisans]] during the [[Imperial Era]].<ref name="The Summit" /> In around [[18 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TBBDate|215}}</ref> the Partisan went with Gerrera on a mission to infiltrate the [[Raven's Peak]], an [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] compound where several high-ranking Imperials were meeting for a [[Imperial summit on Eriadu|summit]]. Disguised as stormtroopers, they infiltrated the base and eventually ran into the rogue [[clone trooper]]s of [[Clone Force 99]], who were also infiltrating the base. When their leader, [[Hunter]], asked what they were doing there, Gerrera said they were going to destroy the base and [[Death|kill]] Imperial officers inside. While they tried to talk Gerrera out of going through with his plan, as the clones were tracking one of the Imperial officers inside, the soldier warned Gerrera that a security team had been alerted. The two parties were attacked by stormtroopers and fled. The soldier was wounded in the fight, but Gerrera helped them onto their shuttle before escaping.<ref name="The Summit" />
